      ⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          bbolt.boltTx tx γ q (bbolt.TxView.ro D) ∗ io.writerOk w Wr ∗ Wr c bs₀ -∗

                ∀ n err,
                  (∃ bs,
                      bbolt.boltTx tx γ q (bbolt.TxView.ro D) ∗
                        Wr true (bs₀ ++ bs) ∗
                          (⌜err = GoInterface.nil ∧ bbolt.boltImage bs D⌝ ∗ bbolt.boltImageRcpt bs ∨
                            ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝)) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal n, intoVal err)) -∗
              WP
                ((intoVal
                    (methods go_etcd_io.bbolt.Tx.ty.PointerType go!"WriteTo"
                      (intoVal tx)))
                  (intoVal (GoInterface.ok w)))
                {{ Φ }}
